QBasic RUNNER · PRESS KIT REASSEMBLER

Runs an original QBasic-style program in the browser & reassembles the DOS .COM through WebAssembly

Terminal

idle — press Run. Access code: opensaysme

Program (PRESSKIT.BAS)

Original QBasic-subset program. Edit, then Run. On a correct access code the browser invokes the embedded WebAssembly cipher engine and rebuilds the runnable DOS .com.

This is an original BASIC interpreter and an original QBasic-style program — it does not embed Microsoft's QBasic source. (Microsoft's GW-BASIC on GitHub is 8088 assembly, MIT-licensed — not QBasic, and not GPL.) The DOS .com output is the same self-contained press-kit program as the main app, encrypted via WASM.
